Advertisement for the post of Project Assistant (PA)
Applications are invited for the post of Project Assistant to work in the J&K Science Technology &
Innovation Council sponsored research project in the Department of Chemistry and Chemical
Sciences, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), District-Samba 181143, J&K.
1. Name of the Temporary Post : Project Assistant (PA)- 01
2. Name of the Research
Project
: “Discovery of Selective and orally Bioavailable small molecule for
the Treatment of Triple Negative Breast Cancer”
3. Name of the Sponsoring
Agency
: JKST&IC, Jammu & Kashmir Science Technology & Innovation
Council, J&K
4 Tenure of the Project : 2 Years
5 Tenure of the Assignment : 1 Year (one year initially, extendable to maximum 2 years,
based on the requirement)
6 Job Description : To carry out the research work in the field of synthetic organic
chemistry.

compensation / Fellowship
: Rs. 12,000/- (consolidated).

Terms and Conditions:
 This temporary engagement will be for a specific period and shall automatically stand
terminated with the termination/completion of the project or earlier at the discretion of the
Principal Investigator(s).
 In case the candidate leaves the assignment mid-way, without approval of PI, he/she shall be
liable to pay expenses including salary drawn till date.
 The engagement will not entitle any claim for regular employment in the University.
 Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email and called for interview.
 Shortlisted candidates shall bring the required Qualification Documents in original on day of
interview.
 The candidates called for interview are not entitled to TA/DA.
 The decision of the selection committee will be final. Decision shall be communicated
through email provided.
 Tenure of the assignment for the Project Assistant post shall initially be for a period of 1 Year
and may be extended as per the requirement. However, PI reserves the right to culminate it
before the said period in case of unsatisfactory performance or as per requirement of the
project.
 The application form complete in all respects along with CV, self-attested copies of
qualification certificates, and a recent passport-size photograph should reach the office of the
undersigned, Department of Chemistry and Chemical Sciences, Central University of Jammu,
Rahya- Suchani (Bagla), District Samba–181143, J&K, either as hard copy or by email at
indranil.che@cujammu.ac.in on or before 15-06-2026. The application form can be
downloaded from the University website www.cujammu.ac.in.
 The competent authority reserves the right to fill up or not to fill the vacancies notified in this
advertisement. Waiting list may also be operated if required.
 In case of selection, the candidature shall submit joining within 3 working days failing which
the candidature shall be rejected.
Sd/-
Indranil Chatterjee
Principal Investigator
CENTRAL UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
Department of Chemistry and Chemical Sciences
Bagla (Rahya-Suchani), Samba, J&K-181143
